ruleDefinitions.name: Use Icacls to Hide File to Everyone
ruleDefinitions.description: Detect use of icacls to deny access for everyone in Users folder sometimes used to hide malicious files

sequences.query: ((process_original_file_name = "iCACLS\.EXE" OR process_path = RGX("\\\\icacls\\\.exe$")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/deny.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".**S\\-1\\-1\\-0\\:.*")))
